doc: Shelf/atlas packer step: builds a tile-position header (S_80047270_hdr) for func_80047270 from a per-object header (arg0, same shape as sibling func_80048870's S_80048870_hdr) and a record whose field 0xC is a data-base pointer (arg1, offset by arg2). On a frame-tag change (D_80083164 vs cached D_8008151E) resets the shelf packer (D_80081518=shelf Y, D_8008151A=shelf X cursor, D_8008151C=shelf max height). Advances the X cursor by the tile's width+1, wrapping to a new row (adding the row height, resetting X) past 0x100; resets the whole packer past 0x40 total height; tracks the running max row height; computes the header's tile-space offset fields from the current shelf position and arg0's unk4 tile-size word; writes the shelf position back into arg0 (unk8/unk9, byte-truncated) for later reuse; advances the X cursor by the tile height and calls func_80047270 with the offset data pointer and the built header.

globals.decl: extern u16 D_80083164[]; -- accessed only as D_80083164[0] (%hi/%lo, forced size>8 decl); a live frame/tick counter. SIBLINGS in this wave touch this same symbol -- canonical struct for reconciliation: S_80083164 { /* 0x0 */ u16 frameTag; ... (only offset 0 observed here) }.
